tier_1.why: Owns the state machine. Starts in PaymentPending() and only leaves it when SubmitPressed is handled.
The Stripe call the issue body names. An awaited call that never resolves leaves the bloc pending forever.
The repository hop the issue body names.
THE CONSUMER CASE. Renders the pending spinner and branches on PaymentPending, which it does not declare. Under ownership-only scoring this file is invisible.

tier_2.why: The call site between the bloc and the repository.
Wires the chain; a wrong registration lifetime is a plausible cause.
Where SubmitPressed is dispatched into the bloc.
Declares the event that drives the transition out of pending.
The contract for the repository hop. Thin, so low diagnostic value.

must_not_rank_top_5.why: Generated configuration. Mentions Stripe more than any other file and contains no logic that could hang.
Renders a payment that already succeeded; cannot run while pending.
